description: This file defines application configuration settings, primarily loaded from environment variables, including database URL, JWT secret, expiration, and CORS origins. It contains a dataclass for settings and a function to assemble these from environment variables.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass holding application configuration parameters such as database URL, JWT secret, expiration time, and CORS origins.

methods.name: list[str] _parse_cors_origins(raw: str | None)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of origins into a list of trimmed strings, defaulting to ['*'] if input is None or empty.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from environment variables, providing defaults as necessary, and returns a Settings instance.
